# anthropic_workspace_member (Resource)

Manages a user's membership in an Anthropic workspace through the Admin API.

The user must already belong to the organization. Organization users and
developers must be added to each workspace explicitly. Organization admins
and billing members hold `workspace_admin` and `workspace_billing`
in every workspace through their organization role; that membership cannot be
added, changed, or removed here, so change the organization role instead.

Creating this resource refuses to take over a membership that already exists,
including an inherited one; import an explicit membership instead. An
inherited membership cannot be imported, and a user promoted to organization
admin or billing outside Terraform is removed from state. Destroying
this resource removes the user from the workspace only, never from the
organization. A membership removed outside Terraform, or a workspace archived
outside Terraform, is removed from state and created again on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_workspace" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

resource "anthropic_workspace_member" "alice" {
  workspace_id   = anthropic_workspace.production.id
  user_id        = "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
  workspace_role = "workspace_developer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) ID of the user.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace.
- `workspace_role` (String) Role granted to the user in this workspace: `workspace_admin`, `workspace_developer`, `workspace_restricted_developer`, or `workspace_user`. `workspace_billing` cannot be assigned; it comes only from the organization billing role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<workspace_id>/<user_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_workspace_member.alice wrkspc_01JwQvzr7rXLA5AGx3HKfFUJ/user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu
```
